milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The spruce pressure plate is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 2) on a dark oak plank on the floor. The player must walk toward it and face downward/toward it to visually confirm finding it. Max distance 3 blocks ensures the player is close enough to see this flat floor-level block. Facing tolerance 60° is appropriate since the player needs to look roughly toward the ground-level plate.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The yellow carpet is at spawn-relative (2, 0, 9) on red wool in the back room (behind the dividing wall). The player must navigate past the gate into the back room and face toward the carpet. Max distance 5 blocks ensures the player is in the back room area. Facing tolerance 60° models the player looking at the bright yellow/red contrast block.

Uses inventory_has because mining an oak fence gate drops the oak_fence_gate item into the player's inventory. The player starts without any oak_fence_gate in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over position or block-count rules because the mined item reliably appears in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle door places the resulting item(s) into the player's inventory. The recipe requires 6 jungle planks in a 2×3 pattern on a crafting table, producing 3 jungle doors. The player starts with 6 jungle planks and no jungle_door, so having at least 1 jungle_door confirms successful crafting at the crafting table in the back room.
